title: McpServer
description: One server of the store, as the client sees it (plan 13, B-19). Never a secret value: `envNames` and `headerNames` carry only the names a session would see as environment variables or headers — the API that writes them is write-only (D-02). `status` merges the store's own `enabled` with what a live session currently shows for it (plan 13, B-28, D-45).

scope.description: Every session of the user (`user`), or only below one folder (`folder`).

envNames.description: The names of the env vars this server carries — never their values.

headerNames.description: The names of the headers this server carries — never their values.

status.description: `disabled` whenever `enabled` is `false`. Otherwise what a live session of the caller currently shows for this name, or `pending` with no live session showing it yet (plan 13, B-28, D-45; the per-session equivalent is `session.mcpStatusChanged`).
